Title: General availability: Change data capture in Azure Cosmos DB analytical store

Body.Content:
Change data capture (CDC) in Azure Cosmos DB analytical store allows you to efficiently consume a continuous and incremental feed of changed (inserted, updated, and deleted) data from analytical store. It is generally available now. 

Learn more.
